competingInterpretations.label: STILL-VALID DEPENDENCY (product-coupling reading)
competingInterpretations.argument: E3 supports a genuine product dependency: attention presentation physically overlays composition surfaces, and C4 owns the retirement. Certifying a composer beneath an ungoverned overlay would produce an uncertifiable product behaviour, exactly the failure C3's five-primary episode taught.
competingInterpretations.weaknesses: The roadmap itself makes them parallel (E2). The coupling argument justifies ORDERING SOME OF C5's certification behind C4, not closing the whole chapter.

competingInterpretations.label: DEPLOYMENT-DISCIPLINE GATE, NOT A TECHNICAL DEPENDENCY
competingInterpretations.argument: E2 plus the gate's own wording — implemented, locally certified, pushed, deployed, observed live, live defects resolved, founder declares closed — describes an OBSERVATION PIPELINE, not a code dependency. It belongs to the PB-11 family alongside Phase 5 and the reaper. Its purpose reads as: do not open a second construction front until one has been proven end-to-end in production.
competingInterpretations.weaknesses: This is an inference about intent. No document states the gate's rationale.

competingInterpretations.label: OBSOLETE HISTORICAL SEQUENCING (de facto superseded)
competingInterpretations.argument: E4 shows the frozen §12 contract and the Conversation Completion Register now govern most of RC-C5's originalScope and are advancing. If those are the operative authorities, the RC-C5 gate governs a chapter whose content has moved to another axis.
competingInterpretations.weaknesses: E5 — nothing authorises that transfer. The RC-C5 gate is founder-frozen and was frozen AFTER much of this work began. Treating it as obsolete would be exactly the 'removing a gate for portfolio convenience' the founder ruling forbids.

competingInterpretations.label: GENUINE BLOCKER, CORRECTLY HELD
competingInterpretations.argument: C4 is the only chapter whose retirement touches producers shared with the canonical incoming-call experience (PB-08), and its evidence base is complete but its inventory grew (E8). Opening C5 while C4's global overlays still fire would build composition surfaces underneath a system scheduled for demolition — which is the same failure class FD-5/C10 forbids ('no temporary authority on surfaces authorised for demolition').
competingInterpretations.weaknesses: Does not explain why C5 specifically, rather than C6/C7/C9, carries the gate.

competingInterpretations.label: NAMESPACE / STATE MISUNDERSTANDING RISK (partly true, not the whole story)
competingInterpretations.argument: E6 and E7 establish that 'C4' and 'C5' each denote two unrelated things. Some observed statements about C4/C5 being blocked or advancing may be about the RIC axis. RIC-C5 is 'explicitly NOT ADVANCED' while RC-C5 is 'BLOCKED by hard gate' — two different sentences that read identically when the prefix is dropped.
